n, m = map(int, input().split())
if n > m:
    n, m = m, n
size = 1 << n
dp = [[10**9] * size for _ in range(size)]
for i in range(size):
    dp[0][i] = 0

for step in range(m):
    newDp = [[10**9] * size for _ in range(size)]
    for c0 in range(size):
        for c1 in range(size):
            if dp[c0][c1] != 10**9:
                limitC2 = 1 if step == m - 1 else size
                for c2 in range(limitC2):
                    allBits = size - 1
                    doneBits = ((allBits & (c1 >> 1)) | (allBits & (c1 << 1)) | c0 | c2)
                    doneBits &= (allBits ^ c1)
                    cost = dp[c0][c1] + n - bin(doneBits).count('1')
                    if cost < newDp[c1][c2]:
                        newDp[c1][c2] = cost
    dp = newDp

minRes = min(min(row) for row in dp)
print(n * m - minRes)
